card.name: Range bounds after a minimum threshold
card.fires_on: Small words or symbols that come right after a lower limit and lead into an upper limit or a time span, such as '<' after 'CLcr ≥30 to'. Also verbs like 'taking' or 'served' that start a condition on a minimum.

modes.label: Kidney function ranges
modes.description: The upper-bound symbol or 'and'/'to' joining a lower limit to an upper limit in mL/min ranges.

modes.label: Opioid-tolerance wording
modes.description: Verbs in the definition of opioid tolerance, which is based on a minimum time on therapy.

modes.label: Veterans clause
modes.description: Words in the equal-opportunity clause about veterans who served on active duty during a war.
